subject: AWS Marketplace: seller settlement & SKU activation - pre-launch checklist
messages:
From: AWS Marketplace Onboarding <aws-mp-onboarding@amazon.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: mp-finance@amazon.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Action items: SKU activation + seller settlement config for ClearLake listing

Hi Aditya / Kimberly,

Thanks for the call earlier — quick follow-up with the items we need to finalize on our side to activate the ClearLake Analytics SaaS listing: 

1) Final SKU mapping file (per-tenant vs per-seat options) — we need the canonical SKU names and pricing tiers. Please attach the spreadsheet with the "sku_id" column filled.
2) Seller settlement details (payee, remittance address, tax form preference). Our finance team needs a contact + W-9/W-8.
3) Entitlement model: do you want tenant-level entitlement (one license key per tenant) or seat-level entitlements (per-user tokens)? This affects metering events and fulfillment payload.
4) Metering event schema: confirm the JSON sample we agreed on (usageType, quantity, customerIdentifier, timestamp). If you have a signed contract with meter semantics, attach.

I attached the onboarding checklist and a sample webhook schema. Once we have the SKU file and settlement info we can issue the activation request (usually 48–72 hours).

Also copying MP Finance for settlement cadence.

Cheers,
Katherine Moore
AWS Marketplace Onboarding
[Attachment: AWS_MPX_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Katherine Moore <aws-mp-onboarding@amazon.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Action items: SKU activation + seller settlement config for ClearLake listing

Katherine — thanks, sending the SKU mapping and settlement stub. Attaching a cleaned mapping workbook (MPX_Seller_SKU_Mapping_v2.xlsx) and our standard settlement terms (Redwood_Settlement_Terms.pdf).

Quick clarifications inline: 
- Entitlement model: we want tenant-level entitlement for ClearLake (one tenant ID per subscription). Seat-based billing will come later as an SKU extension.
- Metering event schema: we confirm the agreed sample. Our runtime emits a single JSON per usage batch; the key field for correlation will be customerIdentifier (tenant_id).
- Billing cadence: Redwood prefers 30-day net settlement aligned to monthly usage reports. If MP requires different windows we can discuss.

Please confirm whether MPX needs an explicit mapping row for the trial SKU (we use a trial flag) or if that can be handled via the fulfillment webhook.

Thanks — I can be on a quick call this afternoon for any follow-ups.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Head, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MPX_Seller_SKU_Mapping_v2.xlsx]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Katherine Moore <aws-mp-onboarding@amazon.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Action items: SKU activation + seller settlement config for ClearLake listing

Katherine / Aditya — adding a couple of operational asks from our side so settlement and fulfillment don't block launch: 

- Reconciliation key: please set the settlement report to include our internal sku_id and the MPX sku code in the CSV (two columns). We rely on that for ledger reconciliation.
- Trial handling: we prefer the trial SKU to be a separate MPX sku (sku_trial_01) so usage spikes during trial don't get billed. If that requires additional setup, let us know the timeline.
- Webhook retries: our ingestion supports idempotency via event_id; recommend MPX include the original event_id in the webhook payload for safe retries.

I attached the reconciliation template. Also, Finance will send a W-9; Marissa is on point for that and will share the signed form.

Kimberly Park
Director, Marketplace Ops
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Recon_Template.csv]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Katherine Moore <aws-mp-onboarding@amazon.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: mp-finance@amazon.com
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Action items: SKU activation + seller settlement config for ClearLake listing

Hi Katherine — attaching the signed W-9 and payee details. We prefer ACH; details are in the W-9 packet.

One operational note: when you activate the listing, can you please set the metering window timezone to UTC and include an ISO timestamp in the usage CSV? That prevents daily cutoff mismatches with our ingestion.

Attaching: W9_Redwood_2027-09-16.pdf

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Finance Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: W9_Redwood_2027-09-16.pdf]

From: AWS Marketplace Onboarding <aws-mp-onboarding@amazon.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: mp-finance@amazon.com, docu-sign@docusign.net
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Action items: SKU activation + seller settlement config for ClearLake listing

Thanks everyone — confirmation below and next steps: 

- Received SKU mapping and W-9. We updated the MPX record to include sku_trial_01 as a separate SKU for trials.
- Entitlement set to tenant-level as requested. Metering window set to UTC with ISO timestamps.
- Settlement: ACH configured; finance will run the first settlement after the first full calendar month. MP Finance has your payee on file.
- DocuSign: seller agreement routed to Aditya for signature. Link: https://docusign.net/Redwood-AWS-SellerAgreement-XXXXXXXX

We will kick the activation job tonight; expected go-live verification email by 2027-09-18 09:00 UTC. If you see any 400s on the fulfillment webhook after activation, include event_id and raw payload and we will escalate immediately.

Thanks,
Katherine Moore
AWS Marketplace Onboarding
[Attachment: MPX_Activation_Summary.txt]
